name: Summa lzhi
source:
The not-so-distant future.
Richard Endark, an employee of one of Heliopolis’ largest corporations, is plagued by disturbing, recurring dreams, making his already miserable, lonely life unbearable. Every day, he rushes to a job he despises, only to return in the evening to his cramped apartment, where only photographs remind him of what he’s lost.

One day, Richard discovers that he’s not the only one having these strange dreams.

And these dreams... are life-threatening.
